name: The Scent of Decay
source:
"In the age of the Plague, you find yourself stumbling into a morbid mystery. Will you find out what is causing the deadly disease?"

[From [url=https://666crows.itch.io/the-scent-of-decay]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“在大瘟疫肆虐的年代，你无意间卷入了一桩骇人听闻的谜团。你能否查明这场致命疫病背后的真正源头？”

[摘自[url=https://666crows.itch.io/the-scent-of-decay]itch.io[/url]]
